Nov 10, 2026

EverQuest Legends Patch Notes- 11/10/2026

Reincarnation Early Access Period

The reincarnation system is available today with purchase of the Premium or Deluxe Editions of Rulers of Kunark!

  • The Standard Edition will gain access to the reincarnation with the launch of Rulers of Kunark on December 8
  • To reincarnate, you must be in a three-class loadout at max level and have a Token of Reincarnation
  • A Token of Reincarnation can be acquired from any Voidling (but not while in an instance)
  • When you reincarnate, the level for each of the three classes and the race in your loadout are reset to level 1
  • Upon reincarnation, you immediately gain a rank in the associated reincarnation AA for each class and race in your loadout
  • The reincarnation AAs each have 3 ranks, each rank grants an escalating passive, and the third class rank for class AAs additionally adds an activated ability
  • All reincarnation activated abilities share a cooldown
  • For completionists, there’s an additional AA that can be leveled up by completing the first, second and third rank of all class reincarnation AAs

Rendering

  •  Improved graphical performance of the game.

Disciplines

  • Disciplines can now be upgraded similar to Spells using motes.

Items

  • Added Fragment Motes, which are rare mote drops with increased upgrade power.
  • The Idol of Forsaken Ideals now has 6 AC.
  • Sergeant's Leather Belt, Handmaiden's Wristwraps, and Handmaiden's Earring now have 3 AC each.
  • Signet Ring of Lord Everling has 10 AC.
  • Throwing a spear now throws the pointed end forward instead of up.

Zones

  • Adjusted difficulty rating (e.g. "This creature would require a small army to defeat") of NPCs in Plane of Hate and Plane of Fear so that the end bosses are differentiated from all other mobs in the zone.
  • Improved pathing in narrow hallways of Nektropos Castle's first floor.

Spells

  • Effects that are triggered on expire are now upgraded one-to-one with the primary spell, excluding Promised Renewal.
  • Denon's Desperate Dirge can now only land on the same target once every 2 ticks (12-17 seconds).
  • When upgrading Cancel Magic the effective spell casting level will be increased by half of the upgrade level. For example, a +4 Cancel Magic will cast two levels above the spell’s base casting level.
  • Summoned items with + upgrades on them now show the upgraded item when you click the item link.
  • Stuns/Mesmerize/Charm/Lull now show their upgraded max levels.
